# Nova Helix Research

> Nova Helix Research is an independent, non-profit, remote-first research collective in 25+ countries. Research leads open research papers, and student and early-career researchers apply online to join a paper's team. It is free to join and everything happens remotely.

Main site: https://novahelix.wuaze.com/
Contact: novahelix.contact@gmail.com

## How it works
- Research leads open and steer research papers.
- Researchers create a free account, browse open papers, and apply with a short message about their experience.
- The paper's research lead reviews the application. If accepted, the researcher joins the paper's team.

## Pages
- [Research papers](https://novahelix.wuaze.com/papers/): open papers you can apply to join
- [Researchers](https://novahelix.wuaze.com/researchers/): the researchers and where they are
- [Research leads](https://novahelix.wuaze.com/leads/): the people who open and steer each paper
- [Education](https://novahelix.wuaze.com/education/): research-skills courses
- [Board](https://novahelix.wuaze.com/board/): governance
- [Contact](https://novahelix.wuaze.com/contact/): send a message or find us on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram
- [Privacy policy](https://novahelix.wuaze.com/privacy/)
